property_summary: For any owner-issued Command to a recording counterparty with nonempty data, the contract forwards exactly that calldata (the recorder stores msg.data and its length equals the requested data length); the mutant's bare 2300-gas transfer sends no calldata at all, so the recorded length stays 0 for any nonempty data.
change_summary: Replace the low-level call with a plain transfer that forwards no data and is limited to 2300 gas.
